proposals.before: Yelü Zhangnu and six others were dispatched bearing letters as envoys to the Jurchen, naming their lord in reproach in hope of a quick surrender.
proposals.after: Yelü Zhangjianu and six others were dispatched bearing letters as envoys to the Jurchen, naming their lord in reproach in hope of a quick surrender.
proposals.reason: Chinese 張家奴 is Zhangjianu, distinct from 章奴 (Zhangnu) later in the chapter; the English conflates them.

proposals.before: On bingyin day park commissioner A Bu was made central army commander-in-chief and Yelü Zhangnu inspector; they led a hundred thousand Fan and Han troops;
proposals.after: On bingyin day park commissioner A Bu was made central army commander-in-chief and Yelü Zhangjianu inspector; they led a hundred thousand Fan and Han troops;
proposals.reason: Same person as 耶律張家奴 should be Zhangjianu, not Zhangnu, to avoid confusion with 耶律章奴.

proposals.before: On yisi day of the twelfth month Yelü Zhangnu rebelled.
proposals.after: On yisi day of the twelfth month Yelü Zhangjianu rebelled.
proposals.reason: Chinese is 張家奴; English Zhangnu wrongly merges him with 章奴.

proposals.before: On guihai day Northern Court Palace Commissioner Xiao Hanjianu was put in charge of Northern Court Privy Council affairs, and Southern Court Palace Commissioner Xiao Temo was made deployment director for the Han people at the imperial encampment.
proposals.after: On guihai day Northern Court Palace Commissioner Xiao Hanjianu was put in charge of Northern Court Privy Council affairs, and Southern Court Palace Commissioner Xiao Temu was made deployment director for the Han people at the imperial encampment.
proposals.reason: Chinese 蕭特末 is the same name elsewhere rendered Xiao Temu; Temo is an inconsistent transliteration.

proposals.before: On wuzi day Zhang Jianu enticed the Bohai of Rao Prefecture and the Central Capital rebel Hou Gai, more than ten thousand men in all, and they attacked and captured Gao Prefecture.
proposals.after: On wuzi day Zhangjianu enticed the Bohai of Rao Prefecture and the Central Capital rebel Hou Kai, more than ten thousand men in all, and they attacked and captured Gao Prefecture.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic uses Zhang Jianu/Hou Gai while literal uses Zhangnu/Hou Kai; align to Zhangjianu and Hou Kai for 張家奴 and 侯概.

proposals.before: On chou day of the sixth month troops of all circuits were registered; those with ten or more mixed livestock were all conscripted.
proposals.after: On yichou day of the sixth month troops of all circuits were registered; those with ten or more mixed livestock were all conscripted.
proposals.reason: Chinese 乙丑 is the yichou day; rendering it as 'chou day' drops the stem and is incorrect.

proposals.before: Sixth month, on chou day troops of all circuits were registered; those with ten or more mixed livestock were all conscripted.
proposals.after: Sixth month, on yichou day troops of all circuits were registered; those with ten or more mixed livestock were all conscripted.
proposals.reason: Same 乙丑 error in the literal English.

proposals.before: Again sent Xini Lie and Yang Li Zhong first bearing the investiture draft as envoys to Jin.
proposals.after: Again Xinilie and Yang Lizhong were first sent bearing the investiture draft as envoys to Jin.
proposals.reason: Literal begins with dangling 'Again sent' without a clear subject; restore the personal name as subject.

decisions.reason: Chinese 耶律張家奴 names Zhangjianu; English Zhangnu wrongly merges him with 章奴, a distinct person later in the chapter.
The Chinese again has 耶律張家奴 as inspector; Zhangnu would confuse him with 耶律章奴 in the next sentence.
十二月乙巳 rebels is 耶律張家奴, after 章奴 has already been executed; Zhangjianu is required to keep the two names distinct.
蕭特末 is the same person already rendered Xiao Temu in this chapter (and in this unit's literal); Temo is an inconsistent spelling of the same name.
張家奴 must be Zhangjianu, not spaced Zhang Jianu or Zhangnu; 侯概 is the same rebel named Hou Kai in the following unit, so Hou Gai wrongly splits the name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 張家奴誘饒州渤海及中京賊侯概

decisions.reason: 六月乙丑 is the full sexagenary day yichou; 'chou day' drops the heavenly stem 乙.
The literal field likewise omits 乙 from 乙丑; yichou day restores the complete sexagenary date.

decisions.after: Again Xini Lie and Yang Li Zhong were first sent bearing the investiture draft as envoys to Jin.
decisions.reason: 復遣 needs a grammatical English subject, but the proposal also respells Xini Lie and Yang Li Zhong; keep those forms and only repair the dangling 'Again sent'.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 復遣習泥烈、楊立忠先持冊稿使金
